goal:
A week of notes becomes one digest page
that fits on one screen and keeps every note title, `a | b` included.

task.text: Repeated titles kept as two lines

claim.text: Anti: the digest drops a note whose title repeats an earlier one.

decisions.text: 2026-03-04: ISC-3 counts a repeated title as two notes; T3 keeps both lines.
2026-03-04: ISC-3.1 splits off a title that repeats across two weeks.

2026-03-05: The digest renders as one page,
  its title order kept line by line as
  T3 writes it.
2026-03-03: T3 compares titles case-sensitively; ISC-3 names no folding.
2026-03-05: A repeated title keeps its own line (ISC-3).
